  "newConclusionConnections": [
    "279 identifies the finite p41 background quantities POINTWISE with the SAME actual Fin-m physical U/jackknife statistic for every enumeration e of actual B, with ambient n>=4 and m=card(B)>=4. The sampled x_B, scaledResidual=lambda*r with lambda=(m-2)/(n-2), and all erased-row sums retain the original ambient n-2. W_B+D_B equals the actual backgroundNumerator, centeredSq equals Q0/(m-1), sqrt(centeredSq)=s_B and the actual jackknife root=2*s_B. The physical statistic equals the explicit zero-guarded N_B/s_B and its total-division version; s_B=0 gives statistic0 without claiming N_B=0. No ordering/injectivity of observed values or positive-energy/probability premise is added; arbitrary e is handled through exact symmetric double counting. n>=8 plus n<=2card(B) derives the physical m>=4 requirement.",
    "280 lifts original mu-AE nonnegative w and mu.prod(mu)-AE |r(a,b)|<=w(a)w(b) to ONE common event E_n under the actual finite product mu^n, for EACH fixed n and arbitrary measurable Omega/probability mu. E_n requires all coordinate weights nonnegative and all DISTINCT-INDEX sample-pair envelopes; repeated observations and arbitrary r(a,a) values are retained. For x in E_n, POINTWISE forall real row vectors v and forall finite B, the qualified278 ell^2/2 anomaly bound and original-n-2 row/coefficient1 centered-norm perturbations hold, with only their explicit n>=4/cardB>=3 branches. With measurable uncurry(r),w, E_n is genuinely measurable and both ENNReal and real probabilities equal1. No r/w measurability is silently added to the bare AE implication, nor is selector/statistic measurability inferred."
  ],
